territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Morocco levies a value added tax of its own under the Code général des impôts, articles 1er and 89 to 125, at a standard rate of 20 % (article 99-A, édition 2026, Direction générale des Impôts).
